_about: Models the Kaggle endpoint can serve. kaggle/tools/build_endpoint.py writes the chosen entry into the pushed kernel (default: 'default'). 'pattern' is a regex matched against the repo's file paths and must hit exactly one GGUF. Every entry needs an MTP build: without MTP the endpoint is ~40% slower (15.5 vs 26.8 tok/s, docs/results/SPEED_LEVERS_EVAL.md).

unsloth-ud-q4kxl.note: Production since 2026-09-22. Measured: 15/15 control, 12/18 hard fast pass, 24-30 tok/s live. BAKE-OFF 2026-10-30 winner: F 14/24, T 21/24, 23.4 tok/s.

fable-cold-fusion-735.note: Bake-off candidate. Fable Cold Fusion, coder-tuned. Self-reported ARC-C 0.735 (base 0.591). MTP tensors at Q8_0. BAKE-OFF 2026-10-30: F 14/24, T 15/24, 17.6 tok/s (75%) - lost.

jumbo-fusion-747.note: Bake-off candidate. Reasoning fusion of 20 models, terse output, fewer thinking tokens. Self-reported ARC-C 0.747; card warns coding may be weaker. BAKE-OFF 2026-10-30: controls 8/10 (ineligible), F 14/24, T 16/24, 19.3 tok/s - lost.

coder390-efficientthink.note: Bake-off candidate. Coding + efficient-thinking post-train (SFT/RLOO), MTP head at Q8. BAKE-OFF 2026-10-30: F 14/24, T 17/24, 16.9 tok/s (72%) - lost.
